mechanics.claim: E is a toggle that grants access to EQ/EW/EE abilities; casting any of them exits the mood.
mechanics.quote: '''Hwei''' enters a tumultuous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

mechanics.claim: Toggled activation of the mood does not count as an ability activation for on-cast trigger effects.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Grim Visage's slow is stronger the farther the target is from Hwei at the moment of the hit.
mechanics.quote: formula=70% + 1% for every 38 units the target is away from Hwei at the time of being hit

mechanics.claim: Grim Visage's slow stacks multiplicatively with Crushing Maw's and other Hwei slows.
mechanics.quote: Grim Visage's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.

mechanics.claim: Gaze of the Abyss locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion after a delay, then launches at them after a further delay, dealing damage on collision with the first enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.7}} seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion or otherwise remains there until an enemy champion is in range. Once locked on, the eye launches itself at the target after a {{fd|0.3}}-second delay and collides with the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Crushing Maw snaps and deals damage 0.6 seconds after the start of cast time, slowing enemies with a decaying slow.
mechanics.quote: conjures a jaw at the target location that snaps after {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
